mid.rationale: The archive confirms memory_91 (activation_messaging) delivered +6% activation lift with +1% retention upside and no downside risk. This directly addresses our 6% QoQ activation decline. Given we have one experiment slot this week and our primary objective is sustainable long-term qualified revenue, in-product activation messaging is the highest-confidence play: it targets the immediate symptom (activation drop), has proven retention safety, and complements the onboarding work already underway (memory_86). A standard_experiment scope allows us to measure the effect in current conditions and validate whether the +6% lift persists despite competitive pressure and cohort changes.

final2.rationale: Competitive dynamics have shifted materially. Memory_73 demonstrated that targeted promotional pricing is effective for price-sensitive SMB segments with strong acquisition and revenue lift. Churn conversations have doubled this week among SMB accounts—a direct threat to qualified revenue. Activation_messaging (our prior choice) addresses engagement but does nothing to counter price-driven defection in the immediate term. Promotional_pricing is the only candidate designed to retain price-sensitive SMB revenue at risk right now. Memory_73 shows no reported retention harm and delivered both acquisition and revenue lift, making it the highest-confidence defense against this specific competitive threat. We can run this in parallel with activation_messaging next cycle. The standard_experiment scale allows us to measure retention and revenue impact under current competitive pressure while preserving the option to adjust or expand based on results.
